$comment: AGENTS.md and PRD.md §0.2: the official documentation is installed as pinned skills, by
source, path and SHA-256. Nothing in this repository is written from memory about any of
them (§0.3). When a pin no longer matches, upstream changed: re-inspect, record the
discrepancy in DECISIONS.md, and adapt while preserving the thesis in PRD §4.
Verify with `pnpm skills:verify`. Fetch with `pnpm skills:install`.

skills.what: DreamDEX developer documentation, Event Contracts section
DreamDEX Bot Kit. PRD §8.3: the baseline maker's lineage.
Hackathon starter template. PRD §8.3: the app base. Carries solidity/src/IEventContracts.sol, the on-chain interface for a binary pool.

files.why: The book read, the price scale and the pool interface are taken from this file. Assize samples getBookLevels, so a change here changes what a sample is.

skills.what: @somnia-chain/markets-sdk. PRD §8.3: book and trade streams into the web surface, and live market metadata for the probes. PRD §0.4 prefers its methods over hand-rolled contract calls.

Somnia on-chain reactivity reference. The precompile address, the SomniaEventHandler._onEvent convention, subscription funding and automatic removal, and the two reactivity JSON-RPC methods. PRD §4 and §8.2 rest on this; DECISIONS.md D-001 cites it.
Somnia reactivity overview, distinguishing on-chain from off-chain reactivity. Assize uses on-chain reactivity for Path R.
@somnia-chain/reactivity-contracts. SomniaEventHandler and SomniaExtensions, which CoverageSubscriber inherits from in Phase P2. Not yet installed: P1 deploys nothing and writes no subscriber.

$notes: All four items in AGENTS.md §0.2's pinning list are now pinned: the DreamDEX developer docs, the
Bot Kit, the starter template, and the Somnia reactivity reference. The markets SDK and the
reactivity contracts package are pinned alongside them.
@somnia-chain/reactivity-contracts is pinned but not installed: Phase P1 deploys nothing and
writes no CoverageSubscriber. It is installed in the P2 change that first inherits from
SomniaEventHandler, and `pnpm skills:verify` reports it as not installed until then.
